title: Custom Office & Business Furniture | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Custom furniture for offices, receptions, meeting rooms and executive offices. Design, production and installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
h1: Custom furniture design and manufacturing for commercial properties

blocks.text: Custom furniture design and manufacturing for commercial properties

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) specializes in designing and manufacturing custom furniture for commercial spaces. We develop furniture that reflects the architecture of the space, the specifics of the business, functional requirements, and the company’s corporate identity.

We create furniture for offices, stores, boutiques, beauty salons, showrooms, and other commercial properties. Each project is developed individually — from the initial concept and technical solutions to the manufacturing, delivery, and installation of the finished furniture.
For office and corporate spaces, we design custom furniture that helps create an efficient work environment and supports a cohesive interior style.
We design:

items: desks and furniture for executive offices;

parts.html: The dimensions, configuration, materials, and interior fittings of the furniture are determined individually for each specific space.
For stores, boutiques, and showrooms, we design retail furniture that combines functionality with the brand’s visual concept.
We design display cases, shelving, sales counters, checkout areas, storage systems, fitting rooms, decorative panels, and other bespoke elements of the retail space.
We pay special attention to the convenience of customers and staff, product presentation, and the efficient use of retail floor space.
We design furniture for beauty salons, studios, and other service spaces.
This may include reception desks, workstations, cabinets, storage systems, client waiting area furniture, decorative elements, and built-in structures.
In the design process, we take into account the ergonomics of work processes, the intensity of use, and the specifics of each business.
Every piece of furniture is designed to suit the dimensions and architecture of the space.
We work out the construction, proportions, materials, hardware, opening systems, interior fittings, and the way the furniture interacts with other interior elements.
This approach makes the most of the available space and produces furniture that becomes part of the overall architectural concept of the commercial interior.
For the production of custom furniture, we prepare detailed working drawings and technical specifications.
The documentation defines the dimensions, structural solutions, materials, interior fittings, hardware, and other parameters required to manufacture the furniture.
This makes it possible to work out technical details in advance and ensure that the finished furniture matches the design as developed.
Materials are selected based on the design, the purpose of the furniture, the operating conditions, and the project budget.
For commercial spaces, wear resistance, practicality, ease of maintenance, and the reliability of the structures and mechanisms used are particularly important.
We select materials and hardware so that the furniture combines aesthetics, functionality, and durability.

blocks.text: Furniture as part of a commercial interior

parts.html: Custom furniture can support a company’s corporate identity and become an important part of the visual identity of the space.
Colors, materials, shapes, decorative elements, and brand graphics can be integrated into the furniture design and unified with the overall interior concept.
This is especially important for reception areas, stores, boutiques, showrooms, and other spaces where the interior directly engages with customers.

Manufacturing, delivery, and installation. DUMSKAYA DESIGN offers a comprehensive approach — from concept development and furniture design to manufacturing, delivery, and professional on-site installation. This makes it possible to ensure that the finished pieces match the approved design and technical documentation.
We create custom furniture solutions for commercial properties with functionality, ergonomics, aesthetics, and the specifics of each business in mind.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN — design and manufacturing of custom furniture for offices, stores, boutiques, beauty salons, and other commercial spaces.
